questions.question: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, what should happen?

options.text: The larger vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can go when it is safe.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the car to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the car to go.
questions.explanation: When your car skids, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the car to go. When the car starts to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may have to swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may have to swerve into traffic to avoid an object on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing a bicycle because the cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully around bicyclists.

questions.question: Your vehicle is in an accident and is blocking traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
Do not move your vehicle under any circumstances.
Wait for police to arrive before moving your vehicle.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
questions.explanation: After a minor accident, move your vehicle off the road if you can. Do not leave the scene without giving your information and helping if needed.

questions.question: How dark can the tint be on your front door windows?

options.text: 100 percent light blockage.
Whatever looks good.
65 percent light blockage.
50 percent light blockage.

questions.correctAnswerText: 65 percent light blockage.
questions.explanation: You can tint your side and rear windows. Front door windows can only be tinted to block no more than 65 percent of light.

questions.question: When leaving a highway, when should you slow down?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
When you see a toll booth.
After you have moved into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you have moved into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane well before your exit. Do not slow down until after you have entered the exit lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Go through the intersection carefully. You do not always have to stop.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection pass first. Go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: It can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
It has a triangular shape.
It is blue with black letters.
It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Signs on curves and turns show a recommended speed for those areas. Even if you feel comfortable going faster in good weather, never speed in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Do not enter.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead.
One-way traffic.
Limited parking.
Playground ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles displaying this sign are driving 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help you drive safely at night?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows make it harder to see in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: Looking into oncoming headlights makes your pupils shrink. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to darker light. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow mean at a traffic signal?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
You may turn in the direction the arrow points.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following EXCEPT:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much alcohol you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, the time between drinks, and your weight. It does not depend on your fitness level or how well you think you can handle alcohol.

questions.question: You reach an intersection blocked by traffic ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Move slowly until traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can drive all the way through.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if you cannot drive all the way through. Wait for traffic ahead to clear so you don't block the intersection.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn them to the right.
Turn them to the left.
Keep them pointed straight ahead.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them to the right.
questions.explanation: When parking on a downhill slope, turn your wheels toward the side of the road. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to a solid yellow line, you may pass only if you are in the lane with the broken line.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Always pull to the right edge and stop for an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: You are on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing the lanes. What can you do?

options.text: Cross them only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross them to pass other vehicles if no cars are coming.
Never cross them.
Cross them only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross them only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may cross them only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your parking space.
Back up slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your parking space.
questions.explanation: After checking traffic and signaling, stop parallel to the car in front of your desired spot. Then turn your wheel to park.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs. They give drivers directions and distances.

options.text: Yellow
Red
Green
White

questions.correctAnswerText: Green
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show directions and distances to specific places. They help drivers who are unfamiliar with an area.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: They are placed at every location where danger exists.
They tell drivers what they must or must not do.
They are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
They warn drivers about nearby school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with white background and black text. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing rules, no turning rules, and other driving laws.

questions.question: When you get in a car to drive, what should you adjust first?

options.text: Your seat belt
The steering wheel
Your rearview mirror
Your seat

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat
questions.explanation: First, adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel after your seat is set.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with a flashing red light. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive through the intersection carefully.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Then you can go when the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Come to a stop.
Go straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver raises their left arm and hand upward, it means they plan to turn right. Change how you drive if you are following this driver.
